- The post office records a message as delivered, and flushes the record to disk, before it writes the message to the CLI. A crash between the two, the machine's included, can then only lose a send, which shows as interrupted, and never repeat one. If the record can't be written, the message isn't sent: it stays queued, and its row says why, as in `waits · records can't be written · disk full`.
